title: PostgreSQL Evidence Source Record
description: A content-light reference to a canonical evidence record stored in PostgreSQL. Digest-based identity only; canonical evidence ledgers remain the authority.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier derived from canonical evidence content hash.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA256 digest of the canonical evidence payload.

source_ledger_path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 hash of the source ledger path (content-light).

source_schema_version.description: Schema version of the canonical evidence artifact.

provenance.description: Content-light provenance metadata (session_id, task_id, etc.). Must not contain raw file contents, prompts, model outputs, secrets, or paths.
